params.message:
A trend names the need it serves

driver_tags on insights: one or two of the Standard's six drivers (security,
belonging, status, autonomy, mastery, meaning), the first the main need. The writer
names it for new trends (needsPrompt), writeInsight keeps only ids the Standard
knows, the showcase projection carries it to the site, and bin/assign-needs.mjs
writes a reviewed list for the trends written before the field existed.
